reports.title: Applied Optoelectronics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Business Outlook (+)
section: For fourth quarter of 2026, the company currently expects:

· | Revenue in the range of $385 million to $420 million.
· | Non-GAAP gross margin in the range of 29.5% to 31%.
· | Non-GAAP net income in the range of $45.9 million to $60.4 million, and non-GAAP income per share in the range of $0.48 to $0.63 using approximately 96 million shares.
